description: One Capture per page, in page order: each is the exact body that page's origin sent. Its HTTP coordinate (the page's built URL) with page_index (0-based) and page_count, and its observation time, are the Capture's own. A page without a Capture is listed in failed_pages and the result is then incomplete, so absence never retires on it. A request with no values to page over sends nothing: captures is empty and the result is complete.
name: web.fetch.pages.result
